summary: Consumer Portfolio Services, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, reporting the closing of an $80 million asset-backed securitization of residual interests from previously issued securitizations. The notes, purchased by a qualified institutional buyer, carry a 10.25% coupon and are secured by pledged residual interests in four CPS securitizations issued between April 2022 and April 2023, plus an 80% interest in a majority-owned affiliate holding residual interests in three securitizations issued between July 2023 and April 2026. Monthly payments cover interest and principal to maintain a minimum collateral ratio. This is ordinary-course financing, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or unusual terms were disclosed. What to watch: monthly payment performance and collateral ratio maintenance.
